translation: [Figure: chest bone figure 24] The chest muscle is the xiaogan bone (𩩲骭骨), which is the collective name for all the bones of the chest and flanks. It is also called the ying bone (膺骨), also called the yi bone (臆骨), and commonly called the chest cavity (胸膛). On its two sides, from below the armpits down to the end of the ribs, the whole is collectively called the flank (脅); the small ribs below the flank are called the jixie (季脅), commonly called the soft ribs (軟肋); the rib (肋) refers to a single strip of bone, and the totality of the flank and ribs is also called the qu (胠).
